name: Chichigami Manami
source:
She is the wife of Chichigami Jinnosuke, the head of the Chichigami family and mother of Rio and Kana.

Her exceptionally good looks and unrestrained pheromones instantly captivate men who come to the mansion.

She always dresses herself in clothes that expose her chest. Men cannot help but look at her cleavage.

Manami is a woman with a very welcoming personality that exudes motherly love but don't get on her bad side as she is said to be extremely scary when angered.

[spoiler] Manami is a Miko who has been living for over 500 years, she has been cursed by the father god to serve him for saving her life. Since then she has given birth to 20 daughters and has raised each one. Rio and Kana are her most recent daughters. [/spoiler]

[spoiler] In the true ending, her curse is lifted. She remarries Onimaru and together they have a daughter named Mirai who represents a new future for Manami.[/spoiler]
